prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when Driver 1 signaled and moved toward the right lane. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in that lane, was alongside and the two vehicles made contact along their sides, producing a sideswipe collision. The point of contact on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the damage observed on both vehicles, and the damage pattern matches the impact described by each driver. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that agree with both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene show the same damage and positions of the vehicles. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was noted during inspection. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. A passenger was present in the vehicle, but the exact seating position of the claimant at impact could not be fully confirmed from the information available. Injuries reported are consistent with the type and force of the collision.
